title: Men's Marathon World Rankings: November 2026
desc: The top ten in World Athletics' men's Marathon (Half Marathon) event ranking as of 3 November 2026. Values are ranking points, not race times; associated half-marathon performances can contribute. This dated snapshot covers only the top ten and the live source may change.
